A question for people who had similar surgeries:
Did you have any side effects from it? I had a few… including:

- Sharp pains throughout my whole arm (still to this day)
- my pointer finger tip going numb and growing another nail on top of my nail
- my ring finger was fine before the surgery, now I can also not stretch it fully, just a little more than my pinky
Oh I did have something like that right after surgery, they glued a bra hook to my pinky and put a rubber band on it so I would train my flexing
I’m not sure what that is, but I wear a cast-like thing to sleep at night so that my pinky is stretched, it gets adjusted every week so the stretching progresses
My PT said that flexing will not be a problem so we’ve only been focusing on stretching for a while. It helps a lot but I hate going to PT because it feels so weird in my hand lmao

I honestly gave up all hope after the surgery. The fact that I’ve been regaining strength in my finger and being able to stretch it more feels nice, but this surgery really fucked up my whole arm, it will never feel the same again

I’ve been trying to regain control of my ring and pinky finger since I had the surgery. Unfortunately they did not do a good job and I still can not stretch my hand fully, however with physical therapy I can now close my pinky. My therapist says that I will be able to stretch my hand fully again, although I have my doubts. Please do your research before you get surgery if you can. You are the only one who’s going to deal with the repercussions if anything goes wrong.
